narrative.overview: A restrained analytics workspace using the user-approved green palette, system typography and aligned numeric rows. Progressive disclosure preserves depth without delaying the main report.
keyCharacteristics: One system family and two weights
Flat evidence panels and thin dividers
Three metrics with a real-count line chart
Source and freshness once in the footer

rules.name: Chart-only color
rules.body: Use chart green for data geometry, never text.

rules.name: Single voice
rules.body: Use one system family with regular and semibold weights.

rules.name: Flat at rest
rules.body: Panels have a border; shadows belong to transient help and status.

dos: Preserve exact counts and source links.
Keep additional records available in place.
donts: Do not add eyebrow labels or decorative symbols.
Do not change Worker calculations as part of presentation.
